turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Over the past 2 months, my shortness of breath has been getting worse, especially when I’m active, and it doesn’t happen at rest. I’ve also had an occasional dry cough, but I haven’t had any fever, chills, or night sweats.
[ASK] Are you experiencing **chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)**?

I’m not sure if I have COPD, but I’ve had progressively worse shortness of breath with activity over the last 2 months, and only an occasional dry cough. I don’t have fever, chills, or night sweats. I’ve been a long-time cigarette smoker.
